description: This file defines the GammaDistribution class, implementing the gamma distribution with methods for density calculation, cumulative probability, and random sampling. It includes detailed parameter handling, mathematical computations, and distribution properties.

classes.name: GammaDistribution
classes.description: Implements the gamma distribution, providing methods for density, cumulative probability, sampling, and distribution properties.

methods.name: getShape
methods.description: Returns the shape parameter of the distribution.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Returns the scale parameter of the distribution.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Calculates the probability density function value at a given point, handling overflow via mathematical identities.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Computes the natural logarithm of the density at a given point with overflow management.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the cumulative distribution function at a given point using the regularized gamma function.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution (shape * scale).

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution (shape * scale^2).

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper support bound (positive infinity).

methods.name: isSupportLowerBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates whether the lower support bound is inclusive (true).

methods.name: isSupportUpperBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates whether the upper support bound is inclusive (false).

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a random sample from the gamma distribution based on shape and scale parameters, using different algorithms for shape < 1 and shape >= 1.
